          "scenarioIds": [
            "K8S08"
          ],
          "instructions": "Install only for admission scenario. Core mutating phase is a no-op. Submit each ConfigMap as a separate request; the rejected proposal must never be persisted.",
          "objects": [
            {
              "apiVersion": "rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1",
              "kind": "Role",
              "metadata": {
                "name": "demo-writer",
                "namespace": "demo-dev"
              },
              "rules": [
                {
                  "apiGroups": [
                    ""
                  ],
                  "resources": [
                    "configmaps"
                  ],
                  "verbs": [
                    "create",
                    "get"
                  ]
                }
              ]
            },
            {
              "apiVersion": "rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1",
              "kind": "RoleBinding",
              "metadata": {
                "name": "alice-demo-writer",
                "namespace": "demo-dev"
              },
              "subjects": [
                {
                  "kind": "User",
                  "name": "oidc:alice",
                  "apiGroup": "rbac.authorization.k8s.io"
                }
              ],
              "roleRef": {
                "apiGroup": "rbac.authorization.k8s.io",
                "kind": "Role",
                "name": "demo-writer"
              }
            },
            {
              "apiVersion": "admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1",
              "kind": "ValidatingAdmissionPolicy",
              "metadata": {
                "name": "demo-training-label"
              },
              "spec": {
                "failurePolicy": "Fail",
                "matchConstraints": {
                  "resourceRules": [
                    {
                      "apiGroups": [
                        ""
                      ],
                      "apiVersions": [
                        "v1"
                      ],
                      "operations": [
                        "CREATE"
                      ],
                      "resources": [
                        "configmaps"
                      ],
                      "scope": "Namespaced"
                    }
                  ]
                },
                "validations": [
                  {
                    "expression": "has(object.metadata.labels) && 'training' in object.metadata.labels && object.metadata.labels['training'] == 'approved'",
                    "message": "demo ConfigMaps require training=approved"
                  }
                ]
              }
            },
            {
              "apiVersion": "admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1",
              "kind": "ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding",
              "metadata": {
                "name": "demo-training-label"
              },
              "spec": {
                "policyName": "demo-training-label",
                "validationActions": [
                  "Deny"
                ],
                "matchResources": {
                  "namespaceSelector": {
                    "matchLabels": {
                      "authflow.example/fixture": "true"
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          ]
        },

        {
          "id": "projected-workload",
          "classification": "core scenario extension",
          "scenarioIds": [
            "K8S09",
            "K8S12"
          ],
          "instructions": "Worker builds the local demo reader image and pins its digest for any live run. The example is deliberately not a downloadable third-party workload. Explicit projection still works with automatic mounting disabled. For API TLS, provide trusted CA separately; never skip server verification.",
          "objects": [
            {
              "apiVersion": "v1",
              "kind": "Pod",
              "metadata": {
                "name": "demo-reader",
                "namespace": "demo-dev"
              },
              "spec": {
                "serviceAccountName": "reader",
                "automountServiceAccountToken": false,
                "containers": [
                  {
                    "name": "reader",
                    "image": "authflow-reader:local",
                    "imagePullPolicy": "Never",
                    "volumeMounts": [
                      {
                        "name": "identity",
                        "mountPath": "/var/run/demo-identity",
                        "readOnly": true
                      }
                    ]
                  }
                ],
                "volumes": [
                  {
                    "name": "identity",
                    "projected": {
                      "sources": [
                        {
                          "serviceAccountToken": {
                            "path": "api-token",
                            "audience": "https://kubernetes.demo.example",
                            "expirationSeconds": 3600
                          }
                        },
                        {
                          "serviceAccountToken": {
                            "path": "vault-token",
                            "audience": "vault.demo.example",
                            "expirationSeconds": 3600
                          }
                        }
                      ]
                    }
                  }
                ]
              }
            }
          ]
        },

TokenRequest POST /api/v1/namespaces/demo-dev/serviceaccounts/reader/token; TokenReview POST /apis/authentication.k8s.io/v1/tokenreviews. Authorization header on review uses the reviewer credential, not spec.token.",

              }
            },

      "configurations": [
        {
          "id": "core-api-configuration",
          "classification": "core",
          "scenarioIds": [
            "K8S01",
            "K8S02",
            "K8S09"
          ],
          "configurationFiles": {
            "authentication.yaml": {
              "apiVersion": "apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1",
              "kind": "AuthenticationConfiguration",
              "anonymous": {
                "enabled": false
              },
              "jwt": [
                {
                  "issuer": {
                    "url": "https://issuer.demo.example",
                    "audiences": [
                      "kubernetes-demo"
                    ],
                    "audienceMatchPolicy": "MatchAny"
                  },
                  "claimValidationRules": [
                    {
                      "claim": "tenant",
                      "requiredValue": "demo"
                    }
                  ],
                  "claimMappings": {
                    "username": {
                      "claim": "sub",
                      "prefix": "oidc:"
                    },
                    "groups": {
                      "claim": "groups",
                      "prefix": "team:"
                    }
                  },
                  "userValidationRules": [
                    {
                      "expression": "!user.username.startsWith('system:')",
                      "message": "human username must not use a system prefix"
                    },
                    {
                      "expression": "user.groups.all(group, !group.startsWith('system:'))",
                      "message": "mapped human groups must not use a system prefix"
                    }
                  ]
                }
              ]
            },
            "authorization.yaml": {
              "apiVersion": "apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1",
              "kind": "AuthorizationConfiguration",
              "authorizers": [
                {
                  "type": "Node",
                  "name": "node"
                },
                {
                  "type": "RBAC",
                  "name": "rbac"
                }
              ]
            }
          },
          "arguments": [
            "--authentication-config=/etc/demo/authentication.yaml",
            "--authorization-config=/etc/demo/authorization.yaml",
            "--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.demo.example",
            "--api-audiences=https://kubernetes.demo.example",
            "--service-account-signing-key-file=/etc/demo/sa-signing.key",
            "--service-account-key-file=/etc/demo/sa-verification.pub",
            "--service-account-extend-token-expiration=false"
          ],

    "profile": {
      "researchDate": "2026-10-21",
      "selectedKubernetes": "v1.37.1; confirmed published stable patch through official release page and release tag; not a claim that it is the newest available patch",
      "releaseCaveat": "The release page lists v1.37.2 with a 2026-10-13 target under Upcoming Patch. A passed target date is not proof of release. Before implementation freeze, record tag/commit or image digest and source revision; do not silently change this profile.",
      "maturity": [
        "AuthenticationConfiguration and configurable anonymous endpoints: stable since v1.34.",
        "client-go exec credential plugins: stable since v1.22; use ExecCredential v1.",
        "ValidatingAdmissionPolicy: stable since v1.30; K8S08 uses admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1.",
        "AuthorizationConfiguration: stable since v1.32.",
        "ServiceAccount token volume projection: stable since v1.20; bound-token default volume mechanism: stable since v1.22. Keep these distinct feature names.",
        "SelfSubjectReview: stable since v1.28.",
        "Constrained impersonation: beta since v1.36, enabled by default in current docs; label and record gate state separately.",
        "StructuredAuthenticationConfigurationEgressSelector is beta in current docs; not needed by default demo.",
        "APIServerWebhookAuthenticationToken is alpha in v1.37; excluded from default profile."
      ],
      "sourceDiscrepancies": [
        "Authentication page repeats --oidc-signing-algs with inconsistent default values (RS256 in its OIDC table and RS512 later). Do not rely on either prose default: explicit RS256 for an optional flag-only profile and pinned-source verification. AuthenticationConfiguration v1 has no signingAlgs field; do not invent one.",
        "Current documentation is moving. Archive consulted sections or tag the implementation evidence. Distinguish chosen teaching policy from Kubernetes implementation defaults."
      ]
    },

    "globalRequirements": [
      "Create a dedicated Kubernetes navigation/workspace group with Human access, Token validation, Authorization/RBAC, Workload identity, and Delegation/extensions families. JWT foundations are their own shared family linked from K8s and existing OAuth/OIDC/JWE lessons. Do not bury Kubernetes inside generic OAuth or silently duplicate existing lessons.",
      "Use canonical events, explicit actor-local holdings and immutable artifact/generation IDs. Track received bytes, parsed untrusted claims, verified signature, validated claims, mapped userInfo, authorization input/verdict, admission proposal/verdict, persisted object and response separately. Reading a claim never creates permission.",
      "Model API authentication/RBAC/admission as local API-server stages; different swimlanes may explain responsibilities but must not fabricate network hops. The API server may read from watch caches; a symbolic storage boundary must not imply every read makes a new etcd network RPC.",
      "Each scenario has a fixed happy path and independently selectable failures with declared policy. Branches must alter the relevant request/claim/key/rule/state, not only the narration. Do not silently recover into another authenticator or grant.",
      "JWT validation requires primary-source rules and profile-specific requirements. Public key retrieval is not proof of trust by itself. Never expose issuer private keys, refresh tokens or plaintext JWE contents to actors that do not possess them. Bearer token display is synthetic and clearly labeled.",
      "Maintain overview/field/exact-object replay parity. Exact history must retain token envelope versus decrypted/validated representation, principal origin, binding rule and namespace; backwards seek must rebuild state deterministically and clear stale grants/results.",
      "Provide a visible decision strip: credential → identity → requested action → matching grant → admission when relevant → result. Show why a step is skipped. Error cards name failing stage, caller identity, actual status and next meaningful action; do not map all 403s to RBAC.",
      "Navigation, source/profile expanders and scenario switches need keyboard focus return, readable 390px layout, no token overflow, accessible branch labels and no color-only success signal. Keep five or fewer actors horizontally; break browser/login and API authorization into linked phases without losing artifacts.",
      "Source panel pins release/profile/feature maturity, RFC section or Kubernetes section, retrieval date, implementation-specific cache policy and limits. Mark symbolic fixtures as symbolic; cryptographic validity requires separately computed test vectors rather than decorative signatures.",
      "Tests should prove state boundaries and failure behavior, not mirror prose. Test route registration, all declared scenario IDs, preservation of existing OIDC/JWT/JWE paths, policy reset, identity mapping, exact-request RBAC decisions, JWT/key/token rotation, representation custody, no post-rejection persistence, and actual mounted field-to-exact-history transitions.",
      "Before claiming runnable Kubernetes conformance, validate config/manifests and critical status/feature behavior against pinned v1.37.1 executable or source. Native-browser evidence remains separate from DOM tests and from live Kubernetes interoperability. Report any source discrepancy instead of inventing a consensus."
    ],

  "windowsSharedContracts": {
    "scope": "14 core scenarios WLOG01–08 and WELEV01–06; optional WELEV07. Existing ADDS crypto, SMB3.1.1, RDP and WinRM lessons are reused/cross-linked, not rewritten.",
    "profiles": [
      "Windows11 supported Enterprise/Pro workstation reference with exact build/servicing date recorded before product-specific claims; ADDS Server2025 target where applicable. No implicit Entra join, Microsoft account, consumer Hello or automatic sign-in.",
      "Classic UAC examples explicitly select legacy/classic Admin Approval Mode and a non-built-in administrator. Administrator protection is a separate current feature with an evidence gate.",
      "Credential Guard state must be recorded: keep opaque LSA credential handles by default; if enabled, represent LSAIso/VBS custody without claiming every secret is plaintext in LSASS. Cached-verifier, local-SAM and service-ticket limits remain distinct."
    ],
    "modelRules": [
      "Use local-call/local-check/local-create events for Winlogon, LSA, SAM, token and AppInfo operations. Do not turn local OS API calls into network packets or describe every such operation as RFC protocol traffic.",
      "Separate credential collection, validation, local logon eligibility, token creation, process creation, profile/desktop readiness, resource access and the user learning a result.",
      "Every token has owner/logon-context/primary-or-impersonation type, user SID, attributed group SIDs, privileges plus enabled flags, integrity/elevation metadata and lifecycle; token copies are not independent authenticated users.",
      "Keep raw input, account verifier, cached verifier, certificate/private-key handle, Kerberos credential and token as different artifacts. Permission to inspect is not possession.",
      "Group/PAC information is attributable to its authority; local policy/alias additions are separate. Do not imply every unlock/elevation refreshes all existing tokens.",
      "Author source/protection/decoded-acceptance events and cleanup/release histories for every readable result. Never give an observer future server/DC knowledge at request or wire receipt.",
      "Diagram logical LSA/authentication-package/SAM/token roles within the same workstation with parent grouping. Keep no more than five horizontal actors; group or split a detailed stage."
    ],
    "ux": [
      "At all times show: device membership, console account authority, local process SID/account, outbound identity, effective logon/elevation policy, and current authentication-versus-authorization decision.",
      "Offer explicit local/domain and classic/Administrator-protection profile selectors before playback, with a textual explanation of what changes. Profile choice resets history rather than mutating a running principal.",
      "Provide token comparison tables and simple labels: credential verified, console allowed, token created, desktop ready, resource allowed. Separate consent, credential verification, local PIN entry and network authentication.",
      "Cross-link exact accepted SMB/AD scenario IDs and retain return-to-origin context; avoid duplicating catalog entries that merely restate an existing protocol flow."
    ],
    "gates": [
      "Before code, capture relevant official page/spec bytes, final URL, revision/build scope, retrieval date and SHA256 under the listed snapshotReference paths; sourceSnapshotStatus must remain pending until bytes exist.",
      "Pin MS-KILE/MS-PAC current versions and revalidate the existing AD03/AD04 Windows profile gates. Do not copy older weak mapping, SHA1/RSA-transport or universal fallback claims from broad legacy articles.",
      "Resolve current Administrator-protection support-label discrepancy. Offline smart-card and WHfB detailed flows are named research branches, not silently omitted promises or fabricated implementations.",
      "For declared product support, record Windows edition/build, DC build, effective policies, token inspection and narrowly scoped logs/traces. Synthetic tests establish authored-model consistency, not interoperability."
    ],
    "verification": [
      "Tests must assert actual negative boundaries and identity/held-object states, not only that scenario labels/step counts exist. Cover wrong-password /netonly launch, cached/no-cache split, same-name SID separation, DC-required unlock, consent-vs-credentials, UAC cancellation, and all key custody transitions reused from AD.",
      "Add field/held-object replay for token creation/consumption/release and protected-result acceptance. For WIN-11 cleanup, author H-local acceptor-subkey creation in six fixed/seven derived raw-CredSSP/RDP profiles without adding the secret to wire objects. Keep its P3 scope separate and do not reopen accepted WIN01–10.",
      "Native UI checks: keyboard through profile selection/prompt/result, readable token comparison at narrow width, no hidden outcome after denial, and correct return cross-links. Root retains existing broader manual/accessibility gates."
    ]
  },
  "evidenceStatus": "Planning requirements and researched references; no new product implementation, native execution, platform interoperability or captured-source-byte hashes are claimed by this plan."
